panels.description: Slope of resident memory over the last 15 minutes. A flat line near zero means no leak; a positive slope that persists across a long run is one. Red line: 10 MB/h (heuristic, tune with the first soak).
panels.title: RSS growth (MB/h)

panels.description: Slope of in-use heap over the last 15 minutes. GC makes it noisy over short windows; trust it after the first 15 minutes. Red line: 10 MB/h (heuristic).
panels.title: Heap growth (MB/h)

panels.description: Slope of the goroutine count over the last 15 minutes. Positive and persistent means goroutines are leaking. Red line: 100/h (heuristic).
panels.title: Goroutine growth (per hour)

panels.description: k6 p95 for the start, middle and end of a soak. The end line sitting above the start line is latency drift.
